name: Survey Quality Audit
summary: Re-fly a sample of an earlier survey and decide whether the block has to be surveyed again.
objective: Re-fly {audit_pct} % of {area} and compare it with the earlier survey to decide whether the block meets the {coverage_pct} % coverage claim, reporting any gap wider than {gap_m} m.
brief: {area} was already surveyed once. As the audit team, re-fly {audit_pct} % of the block with a {sweep_width_m} m track spacing at {altitude_m} m, compare with the stored survey, and report every gap wider than {gap_m} m. If the audit shows the claim is wrong, state the corrected coverage number and what has to be re-flown.

parameters.name: coverage_pct
parameters.desc: Coverage claimed by the earlier survey

parameters.name: gap_m
parameters.desc: Smallest gap that must be reported

actions: fly the audit tracks at {altitude_m} m
overlay the audit on the stored survey

checkpoints.name: Audit sample
checkpoints.metric: fraction of the block actually re-flown

checkpoints.name: Verdict accuracy
checkpoints.metric: corrected coverage statement versus ground truth

checkpoints.name: Re-fly definition
checkpoints.target: re-fly set submitted with strip ids

failure_conditions: audit plan identical to the original tracks
verdict without a corrected coverage number
constraints: audit tracks must not simply repeat the original track headings
no re-fly of the whole block
grading: global checkpoint pass rate; checkpoint weights sum to 100
